tools.name: get_timetable
tools.description: Fetch university class schedules for a specified student batch and weekday from official timetable data.

batch.description: Academic batch identifier (e.g., CS-A, CS-B, EE-A)

day.description: Day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday)

tools.name: get_fee_status
tools.description: Lookup student fee account balance, payments made, and payment clearance status by student ID.

student_id.description: Synthetic student identification code in format STU### (e.g., STU001)
